# 2 Baruch Chapter 79 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 79:1 — chastisement formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "you-were-visited with-chastisement on-account-of-your-sins" |
| LOGOS | "you were visited with chastisement on account of your sins" |
| PNEUMA | "This came upon you as discipline because of your sins" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Visited with chastisement' (Syriac: etteplakhton b-musar) is the classical prophetic formula for divine discipline; PNEUMA's paraphrase 'came upon you as discipline' is less precise.

---

## 79:3 — divine attributes triple formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "he-is-merciful... he-is-good... he-is-a-witness" |
| LOGOS | "he is merciful... he is good... he is a witness" |
| PNEUMA | "He is merciful... he is good... he bears witness" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The threefold construction with 'he is' preserves the Syriac parallel syntax; PNEUMA varies the third term unnecessarily.

---
